task: Dashboard feedback from Irtiza: the update/status text on project cards reads as a run-on, hard to parse. Reformat displayed notes, history entries, and per-persona status lines into clean, scannable bullet points instead of concatenated sentences.

Riley.output: Per-persona status lines are now a real <ul>/<li> list (name/status/output as separate elements) instead of one concatenated string. The 'most recent update' is now a labeled block (LATEST UPDATE / note / by · date on separate lines) instead of one run-on sentence. History entries show 'who · when' on its own line above the note text.
